query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQC_USER_HITLOG VALUES(:FunctionCode,:UserID, :IPAddress, systimestamp, null, :Parameter, null )

UPDATE TQC_USER_HITLOG SET END_TIME = sysdate WHERE FUNC_CODE = :FunctionCode AND USER_ID = :UserID AND IP_ADDRESS = :IPAddress AND START_TIME = (SELECT MAX(START_TIME) FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG WHERE FUNC_CODE = :FunctionCode AND USER_ID = :UserID AND IP_ADDRESS = :IPAddress)

SELECT B.FUNC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG A, TQC_FUNCTION_LIST B, TQC_USER C WHERE A.FUNC_CODE = B.FUNC_CODE AND A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND (A.START_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:StartTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:EndTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) GROUP BY B.FUNC_NAME ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT X.FUNC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT B.FUNC_NAME, A.USER_ID FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG A, TQC_FUNCTION_LIST B, TQC_USER C WHERE A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.FUNC_CODE = B.FUNC_CODE AND (A.START_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:StartTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:EndTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) ORDER BY 2 desc ) X GROUP BY X.FUNC_NAME ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),1,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),7,2) AS DT, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG A, TQC_FUNCTION_LIST B, TQC_USER C WHERE A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.FUNC_CODE = B.FUNC_CODE AND (A.START_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:StartTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:EndTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) GROUP BY SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),1,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),7,2) ORDER BY 1 asc

SELECT SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),1,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),5,2) AS DT, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG A, TQC_FUNCTION_LIST B, TQC_USER C WHERE A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.FUNC_CODE = B.FUNC_CODE AND (A.START_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:StartTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:EndTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) GROUP BY SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),1,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),5,2) ORDER BY 1 asc

SELECT NVL(B.USER_CMF_1, 'No Department') AS DEPT, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG A, TQC_USER B WHERE A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND (A.START_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:StartTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:EndTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) AND B.USER_CMF_1 != '정보혁신담당' GROUP BY B.USER_CMF_1 ORDER BY 2 desc

SELECT C.USER_NAME, B.FUNC_NAME , TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS START_TIME , IP_ADDRESS FROM TQC_USER_HITLOG A, TQC_FUNCTION_LIST B, TQC_USER C WHERE A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.FUNC_CODE = B.FUNC_CODE AND (A.START_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:StartTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:EndTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) ORDER BY 3 DESC
